purpose: Ownership and status only. This file answers WHICH manuscript owns a finding and WHETHER work on it is authorised. It answers nothing about what the finding says.
why_it_carries_no_numbers: A global lock repeating the figures of papers/paper2/claim_lock.json would be a second place a number can live, and two copies of a number stay equal only until one of them is edited. build_paper2_claim_lock_v1.py refuses to build if any numeric value appears below, so this constraint is enforced rather than requested.

standing_rules: one active manuscript, one claim lock, two provenance certificates, one bounded sensitivity, zero new programs before submission
a finding has exactly one primary owner; a second manuscript may cite it but never headline it
